title: Trey Benson a Must-Add Heading into Week 11
description: Arizona Cardinals second-year running back Trey Benson (knee) has missed the last five games with a knee injury and remains one of, if not the best, IR stashes in fantasy football. Benson became the starting running back for the Cardinals in Week 4 after James Conner (foot) was injured and was reported to miss the remainder of the 2025 campaign. Benson had shown flashes of success in his limited snap share with Conner, averaging 5.52 yards per carry through three games on 21 carries. Bam Knight and Emari Demercado are getting the bulk of the workload right now, but neither has done enough to run away with the job. Benson, upon his return, will immediately provide fantasy managers who held on with RB2 value.
